must_identify.item: Pods are in ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull because the tag nginx:1.27-alpne does not exist
must_identify.evidence: The new ReplicaSet frontend-7b6c998456 created pod frontend-7b6c998456-8s5ht, which is stuck Pending/ImagePullBackOff: Back-off pulling image "nginx:1.27-alpne": ErrImagePull: ... failed to resolve reference "docker.io/library/nginx:1.27-alpne": docker.io/library/nginx:1.27-alpne: not found

must_identify.item: The old pods are still serving (rollout stuck, not an outage)
must_identify.evidence: Since maxUnavailable: 25%, the rollout can't fully proceed — it's stuck with 2 old pods available + 1 new pod failing to pull, matching the KubeDeploymentRolloutStuck alert

notes: The RCA never says outright that traffic is still being served. It does say the old ReplicaSet has '2/2 healthy pods' and '2 old pods available', which counts as stating it. Its rollout-mechanics explanation credits maxUnavailable, but maxSurge is what let the extra new pod be created, so a reviewer may want to note that minor inaccuracy.
